entries.title: Color themes on iPhone and iPad
entries.body: Settings, Appearance, Theme on your iPhone or iPad now offers your computer's thirteen color themes beside Device, Dark and Light, under their makers' names, such as Dracula and Catppuccin Latte. A pick recolors the whole app at once, cards and the crew included, on that device only.

picture.alt: The phone's Theme setting as a group of tiles, each a small window in its theme's colors, with Dracula picked on a dark screen and Catppuccin Latte on a light one
